text:
Hi there, and thanks for contacting Leafy! 🌿

Our Plant Care Specialists are available by chat **9am to 5pm, Monday to Friday**, in your local time.

You can also reach them by email at help@leafy.example, and we answer within 1 business day. Their free care advice is open to everyone, whether or not you've ordered from us.

If you need help outside those hours, our general support chat is open 8am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday. Please note we don't offer phone support.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy to help any time, and good luck with your plants! 🪴
